name: Sprite Atlas B — Common Skins (8 tanques × body + cannon)
generation_strategy: Canvas 1536×1024 dividido en 4 columnas × 2 filas = 8 slots de 384×512. Cada slot contiene UN skin: body centrado en la mitad izquierda (192×512), cannon centrado en la mitad derecha (192×512). Misma forma del tanque default, distintos esquemas de color.

frames.role: Atlas de 8 skins comunes: camo, desert, arctic, rust, urban, olive, navy, charcoal
frames.prompt:
Sprite sheet atlas on a 1536x1024 fully transparent canvas. 8 tank skins arranged in a 4-column × 2-row grid of slots, each slot 384px wide × 512px tall. Thin 1px semi-transparent gray lines mark slot boundaries as guides. Art style: vibrant cartoon, cel-shaded with smooth gradient transitions (NOT harsh flat tones), bold 3-4px dark charcoal outlines (#1A1A2E), chunky proportions, Brawl Stars visual quality. Strictly 90-degree bird's-eye overhead view — only TOP SURFACE visible, NO front/side faces.

EVERY TANK BODY shares the SAME chunky structural shape as the reference tank:
  - Roof with multiple armored panel segments separated by engraved lines
  - Prominent circular turret ring/mount in the center of the roof
  - Small armored hatch with 4 rivets
  - Rear ventilation grilles (parallel engraved lines)
  - Two circular exhaust ports near rear
  - TWO wide flat TRACK STRIPS on far left and far right edges — each showing individual chain links from above (row of small rounded rectangles)
  - Bold charcoal outline on all edges
  - Subtle warm drop shadow
  - Chunky squat proportions: wide and low

EVERY CANNON shares the same shape:
  - Narrow elongated rectangle pointing UPWARD (12 o'clock direction)
  - Slightly wider turret base plate at bottom with bolt details
  - Barrel narrows slightly toward muzzle at top
  - Small muzzle brake at tip (slightly wider notch)
  - Bold charcoal outline

SLOT LAYOUT:
Row 0 (y=0..512): slot positions left-to-right at x=0, 384, 768, 1152
Row 1 (y=512..1024): slot positions left-to-right at x=0, 384, 768, 1152

Within EACH slot (384×512):
  - LEFT HALF (192×512): Tank BODY centered at 160×160px
  - RIGHT HALF (192×512): Tank CANNON centered at 128×128px
  - Thin 1px vertical guide line at x-midpoint of slot separating body/cannon

===== ROW 0 SKINS =====

[Slot R0C0, x=0..384] SKIN_CAMO:
  BODY: Classic military camouflage pattern. Base color olive green (#4A6620), irregular darker green (#2D4012) and khaki (#8A7040) patches across all armor panels, same chunky shape. Track strips in dark gray-green (#2A3018). Cel-shaded with warm highlights on raised panels.
  CANNON: Matching olive green (#3D5518) with darker barrel, same camouflage touches, bold outline.

[Slot R0C1, x=384..768] SKIN_DESERT:
  BODY: Desert sand color scheme. Warm sandy beige (#C8A060) base, pale yellow-tan (#E0C080) highlight areas on raised panels, warm brown (#7A5A30) shadow areas and tracks. Panels look slightly sun-bleached with faded paint cartoon effect (lighter worn patches on panel edges). Track strips dark warm brown.
  CANNON: Matching sandy beige (#B89050), slightly more worn look, bold outline.

[Slot R0C2, x=768..1152] SKIN_ARCTIC:
  BODY: Arctic snow camouflage. Crisp white (#F2F2F0) base with soft light gray (#BBBBC8) shadow areas, irregular dark gray (#5A5A6A) camo patches on some panels. Track strips in medium gray (#707080). Looks clean and cold. Cel-shaded highlights are slightly blue-tinted (#E8E8FF).
  CANNON: White (#EBEBEB) with gray (#6A6A7A) accents, bold dark outline.

[Slot R0C3, x=1152..1536] SKIN_RUST:
  BODY: Rusty worn metal cartoon style. Reddish-brown base (#7A3020), bright orange rust patches (#CC5520) on panel surfaces and edges, dark brown (#3A1808) shadow areas and crevices. Track strips in dark rust brown (#5A2010). Despite the worn theme: KEEP cartoon cel-shaded quality, bold outlines — NOT ultra-realistic grime, just stylized cartoon rust.
  CANNON: Matching rust-brown (#7A3020) with orange rust spots, bold outline.

===== ROW 1 SKINS =====

[Slot R1C0, x=0..384, y=512..1024] SKIN_URBAN:
  BODY: Urban gray camouflage. Medium gray (#707080) base, darker gray (#484858) geometric angular camo patches on panels, light gray (#9898A8) highlight areas. Track strips in charcoal gray (#3A3A4A). Clean modern city camo look.
  CANNON: Matching medium gray (#686878) with angular dark gray patches, bold outline.

[Slot R1C1, x=384..768, y=512..1024] SKIN_OLIVE:
  BODY: Solid olive green, no pattern. Rich saturated olive (#5A7A32), warm yellow-green (#7A9A42) highlights on raised panels, deep olive shadow (#384E1E) in recessed areas. Track strips dark olive (#2E3E16). Clean solid-color military look, Brawl Stars saturated style.
  CANNON: Slightly darker olive (#4A6828), smooth gradient, bold outline.

[Slot R1C2, x=768..1152, y=512..1024] SKIN_NAVY:
  BODY: Deep navy blue scheme. Dark navy (#1A2A4A) base, slightly lighter navy (#253566) raised panel highlights, silver-gray (#9090A0) small accent rivets and trim details, tracks in dark navy-black (#101820). Polished naval look with subtle metallic silver details.
  CANNON: Matching dark navy (#182240) with silver trim on tip and base, bold outline.

[Slot R1C3, x=1152..1536, y=512..1024] SKIN_CHARCOAL:
  BODY: Deep charcoal dark gray scheme. Very dark charcoal (#1E1E24) base, slightly lighter charcoal (#2E2E38) on raised panels, subtle dark silver (#5A5A6A) highlight sheen on panel edges. Track strips near-black (#141418). Sleek, stealthy but still with bold outlines and visible cel-shading. NOT pure black — shows depth.
  CANNON: Dark charcoal (#1A1A20) with subtle silver highlight stripe, bold outline.
frames.negative_prompt: side view, isometric, 3/4 angle, front face visible, lateral faces, any angle other than top-down, floating in air, realistic metal textures, photorealistic, pixel art, thin proportions, fragile-looking, pure flat colors without cel-shading, missing track strips, missing turret ring, generic blob shapes, text labels, watermarks, numbers, symbols overlaid on sprites, backgrounds

notes: Después de generar y aprobar el borrador, recortar cada región con scripts/process-asset.js según crop_regions. Los cuerpos (192×512) y cañones (192×512) quedan muy altos — recortar el bbox del sprite real o escalar directamente a game_size sin respetar el padding. Verificar que los 8 tanques mantengan coherencia con tank-default-body.png aprobado.
